newsitem.title: USA: Angeion seeks FDA approval for Sentinel.
newsitem.headline: Angeion seeks FDA approval for Sentinel.

text.p: Angeion Corp said Thursday it was seeking pre-market approval for its Sentinel series 2000, 2010, 2011 and 2012 implantable cardioverter defibrillator systems.
A pre-market approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration would allow Angeion to market the products in the United States, the company said.
The defibrillator systems, which treat abnormal heartbeats, include a Sentinel ICD, AngeFlex leads, programmer and accessories, Angeion said.

"Filing for a pre-market approval on the Sentinel ICDs and AngeFlex lead systems is clearly the most significant milestone in this company's history to date," said Whitney McFarlin, Angeion's chairman, president and chief executive.
"We are very excited to apply for a PMA just 15 months after initiating U.S. clinical studies," he added.
